chapter:
This book began from an imported campaign. Its founding details were incomplete.

The founding party of 10 residents arrived. Kauppi and Sigfrid Bjarnardóttir were already partners at arrival. Dervla and Kauppi were already partners at arrival. Inghild Sigurdardóttir and MaelColuim were already partners at arrival.

housingResult.note: BuildHouse alone preserves occupations, career settings, specialization and cattle assignments.

existingFarmerHousingResult.note: A farmer is explicitly prepared before BuildHouse. Their house activates the existing Farmyard function with no cattle assigned.

farmyardResult.note: A headless feasibility check of existing commands, not implementation of a combined command.

workWithoutHouseResult.note: An occupation can be assigned without building a house or changing animal assignments.
